answer: Root-ranked lock bond: each identity locks 70 credits, and lock length grows with its funding root's rank in the ocean registry — first 1 epoch, k-th k epochs, each sealed by a cipher receipt. One root funding 1,000 fakes waits 500,500 epoch-locks, costing 2,502,500 at 5 credits each plus 70,000 locked. A rented-root ring fails: a fresh root needs funded history, and umber dye marks each rank. Honest agents lock 70 for one epoch and pay 5 once.
